newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sen. Dorgan denounces Fed rate increase.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sen. Dorgan denounces Fed rate increase.

text.p: U.S. Senator Byron Dorgan on Tuesday criticized the decision of the Federal Reserve to increase interest rates, calling it a "new tax" on every American family.
"The Federal Reserve Board is standing logic on its head by increasing interest at a time when inflation is falling," the North Dakota Democrat said in a statement.
"The Fed does not have a right to be wrong when every American citizen is forced to pay for their mistakes," he said in a statement.
A long-time critic of Fed secrecy, Dorgan said "this wrong-headed decision demonstrates the need to disinfect the Fed with a little sunlight."
He added that "no economists lose their jobs as higher interest rates slow down the economy, but plenty of wage earners pay the ultimate price."
